title: Overcoming the Challenges of Integrating Diverse EM Tools into a Unified Research Framework
content: In recent years, electron microscopy imaging technologies have advanced rapidly, offering unprecedented capabilities for studying biological structures across scales. Despite these developments, researchers often specialize in a single EM technique, remaining unaware of the potential offered by complementary approaches. From the perspective of a core facility, introducing users to the appropriate EM tools and helping them overcome initial technical barriers is crucial for maximizing the utility of these technologies. Here, we present a case study demonstrating how diverse branches of electron microscopy, commonly available in a university EM core, can be integrated to address a complex biological question effectively.
